name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the command to reach the exit, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand there, which is the carry-to-goal pattern. Response(box_fell, holding_box) is the untimed consequent of the whenever clause, and holding_box is the only pickup proposition. All three clauses are hard because the task has no preference cue, none is redundant, and no clause adds a requirement the task does not state.

texts: The agent must reach the exit.
Every time the agent is on the exit, it must be carrying the box on that step or later.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again: it must be carrying the box on that step or later.
